title: Very enjoyable walking tour
text:
Karlos - born and bred in Seville - was great. An interesting walk through the backstreets, with some church stops and explanations and finished at the river. 
His English is perfect and he answered all our questions with incredible knowledge.
author: 747gayleg

title: Other than that my tour...
text: Other than that my tour was booked with a Spanish language instead of English language guide, this was a great tour full of very interesting and beautiful important sites.
author: RitaM_P
